title: A transient wrapper 404 opens the REPORT ON GITHUB dialog instead of a toast
description: routes/remoteModels.js:82-90 states the contract: a wrapper route that 404s or 5xxs while a Pod warms is TRANSIENT and must surface as a TOAST, never an error + REPORT ON GITHUB dialog. It does not hold. Live 2026-08-08 during the MPI-467 smoke fill: a cold -cpu download Pod answered /health green before /wrapper/models/install was routable, all 12 ltx-23-balanced deps threw "wrapper install 404" inside 0.2s, and the user got a Download Failed modal offering to file a GitHub issue for a boot race that a re-POST fixed seconds later. Find where the download:failed broadcast is classified renderer-side and route a transient wrapper status to the toast path the comment already promises. Do NOT fix it by widening the retry budget - that hides the instance and leaves the classification wrong.
acceptance: A transient wrapper 404/502/503/504 during Pod warm-up surfaces as a toast, not the error + REPORT ON GITHUB dialog
A GENUINE install failure (bad url, hash mismatch, out of disk) still reaches the report dialog - the fix must not swallow real errors
Proven against the real path: an install POSTed at a cold __cpu__ Pod inside its 404 window, not a synthetic error injection
